description: A shell script used for testing the preservation of subject lines in git patches when applying via 'git am'. It includes functions to create patches with different subject formats, check that subjects are preserved after applying patches, and runs a series of tests with various subject formats including short, long, and multiline subjects.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with specified subject type and message, and outputs patch files.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Applies a patch and verifies that the subject line matches the expected content.
